recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source edit is required unless a future work-group decision changes the retained other processing mode.
issue_request: FHIR-34467 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested dropping the nearby and distance SearchParameter usage modes because they were unclear and could not be generically automated.
initial_application: PR 1964 implemented FHIR-34467 through commit 1a0b67ee41, which removed nearby and distance from source/searchparameter/codesystem-search-xpath-usage.xml, followed by b6ff86dc86 updating the SearchParameter.xpathUsage short text to normal | phonetic | other.
additional_context: SearchParameter is active and approved in source/fhir.ini. Later commits renamed the old xpathUsage terminology and element to search-processingmode and SearchParameter.processingMode, so the current files are the renamed successors of the FHIR-34467 target. FHIR-35974 is the same change family and confirms keeping other while removing the unsupported spatial modes; it already has its own combined-branch audit commit.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Current source/searchparameter/codesystem-search-processingmode.xml contains only normal, phonetic, and other; source/searchparameter/structuredefinition-SearchParameter.xml has matching short text and required binding; targeted source search found no remaining nearby/distance processing-mode concepts.

related_jiras.note: Later tracker/minutes confirm removing location/distance while keeping other; already represented on the combined branch.
PR 1964 also included a separate CapabilityStatement expectation-context fix, but it is outside this usage-mode reconciliation.
